name: The King Night Cream
tagline: Nourish • Repair • Restore | Overnight Intensive Radiance
description: A luxurious night recovery cream formulated with rare botanical extracts and active peptides. Works overnight during your skin’s peak regenerative cycle to repair damage, fade hyperpigmentation, deeply nourish depleted skin barrier, and wake up with illuminated, healthy skin.

Restores healthy natural radiance with no harsh chemicals
